searchText: would other clients keep this endpoint around for supporting blob retrieval on blob archive nodes? perhaps not super useful, they could query historical blobs using the new endpoint too <@491624610215886849> <@466006586477772831> for your old blob_sidecar endpoint arbitrum is doing some testing , post fulu are you guys returning cell proofs instead of blob proofs on the endpoint? I think it should still return blob proofs and not cell proofs ( might be a bug) we are returning empty proofs. we had the discussion on interop i think some of the L2s said that they don't really need the proof. So we haven't changed it yet. Do you guys compute the proof when the api is called? we do just to maintain it will double check though, they thought you were returning cell proofs I think 😅 thanks for the heads up why are they still using that endpoint? I also updated Lodestar blob_sidecars recently to support post fulu and retrun blob proofs etc. but this should just be to make transition for some users more graceful yes they will update, but in the mean time right now from that thread on interop (can't find it now), it felt like the consensus was that the proof wasn't actually required. So we haven't changed it yet that's what the very first PR suggested as well [here](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/524/files#diff-4bdcfd329f9097e648edccd9db8b51314acdad43e621ddc3e45ebab82adc4cd1R13) and then there was consensus to just return the blobs, so I would assume that's fine too
